head_coach.name: Murat Yakin
head_coach.play_style_summary: Flexible and possession-oriented approach focusing on building from the back, maintaining defensive organization, utilizing Granit Xhaka and Remo Freuler as a controlling midfield double-pivot, and using wing-backs to create attacking width.

key_players.name: Gregor Kobel
key_players.performance_stats: The most valuable player in the Swiss squad, starring for Borussia Dortmund and serving as a crucial, consistent shot-stopper during Switzerland's unbeaten World Cup qualifying matches.

key_players.name: Ardon Jashari
key_players.performance_stats: Joined Italian giants AC Milan following a spectacular tenure in Belgium with Club Brugge where he earned Player of the Year honors, solidifying his spot as one of Switzerland's brightest young midfield talents.

key_players.name: Manuel Akanji
key_players.performance_stats: A world-class center-back who recently clinched the Italian Serie A title during his loan spell with Inter Milan, cementing his status as the foundational leader of the Swiss defense.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Sidelined during late May due to a persistent calf injury/strain suffered with Leeds United, though still named to the preliminary World Cup squad.
Sustained a worrying knee injury during the DFB Pokal final with VfB Stuttgart on May 23, 2026, putting his World Cup participation in major doubt.
